name: Dance Of Lurid Longing
source:
Take on the role of an ambitious and self-assured thief who, thanks to a mix of talent and nerve, has just stolen a extraordinarily valuable ring.
Fleeing your pursuers, you find temporary refuge in Lady Lysandra’s castle. The women residing there, much like the lady of the house herself, are eccentric, yet surprisingly hospitable.
Now you must adapt to their local rules, keep your true identity hidden, and deal with the fallout your arrival has caused. But once you discover the castle holds an impressive treasure chamber of its own… After all, you don’t plan on staying here for long, do you?
translation:
扮演一名野心勃勃、自信满满的怪盗——凭借过人的身手与胆识，你刚刚盗走了一枚价值连城的戒指。
为躲避追兵，你暂时藏身于莉珊德拉夫人的城堡之中。居住在城内的女人们正如女主人本人一样古怪离奇，却又出人意料地热情好客。
如今你必须入乡随俗适应城里的规矩、隐瞒自己的真实身份，并收拾好你到来后引发的种种风波。然而，当你发现这座城堡里竟也藏着一间琳琅满目的宝库时……毕竟，你原本也没打算在这里久留，对吧？
